thread:
mia: FYI — ACME trial account reported ~1,230 credits gone overnight. They only run the embeddings sync. Billing shows a tight burst from our bg-sync worker between 02:12–02:18 UTC. Anyone seen this pattern before?
jordan: Ticket #12345 opened. Customer included some logs.
mia: Customer says they only kicked off a single daily sync but saw the job execute multiple times. Their promo TRIAL-1000 was applied once but charges continued for repeats.
liam: Quick update from traces: scheduler retried the same batch 4x because it lost the lease renew. Worker processed each retry because the Authorization header was stripped on replayed requests — so idempotency never fired.
sasha: Stripped by which hop? edge-proxy or internal LB?
liam: Looks like a change in edge-proxy v2 middleware (recent deploy) that rewrites cookies and accidentally clears Authorization for requests replayed from the queue. Repro in staging: when scheduler replays with session cookie present, Authorization header is removed.
liam: repro snippet:
```
# replayed request (from scheduler)
POST /internal/embeddings/sync
Host: api.redwood.example
Cookie: session=abc123
# Authorization header MISSING here on replay
X-Operation-Id: op-20260317-55
```
vs original worker request:
```
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxx
X-Operation-Id: op-20260317-55
```
We see same X-Operation-Id across retries but worker only checks Authorization+payload for idempotency. That means duplicate processing when Auth is missing.
jordan: Billing impact: charged ~1,230 token units across those duplicate runs. Promo logic only applied to initial successful run; retries got billed normally. Customer requests refund.
mia: Immediate mitigation: pause the scheduled sync for that org and block bg-sync for their org id until we patch. Also we should refund and offer extra trial credit for goodwill.
liam: I'll open a PR to: 1) make idempotency primarily use X-Operation-Id in the body/header and return 200 on duplicates, 2) add defensive checks if Authorization is missing on replayed internal calls and fail-fast with a non-retriable error, 3) revert the edge-proxy middleware change that clears Authorization for replayed requests. PR #4567 created.
sasha: I'll pin a rollout hold on edge-proxy v2 and add an e2e test for header preservation. incidents-bot: created incident INC-2309 for auth-header regressions.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2309 created — label: "auth-header-rewrite -> duplicate-processing" — priority P2.
jordan: I'll process manual refund for ticket #12345: refund 1,230 units + grant 1,000 trial credit as apology.
mia: Support action items for ticket: 1) pause org sync; 2) confirm refund issued; 3) follow up once PR merged and edge-proxy rollback done. I'll update the customer and keep them posted. :white_check_mark:
liam: Quick note — after fix we'll run a backfill dedupe job to detect duplicates by X-Operation-Id and mark them as refunded if they match window.
mia: Thanks all — I'll post an internal summary to the account team and add a short postmortem once incident is closed.
